paragraphs.text: Bison is a creature type for cards that depict large, cloven-hooved bovines that live and graze in plains.
All bisons printed so far have been mono- white .
Bison debuted in the Universes Beyond set Avatar: The Last Airbender . The set also contained Bison Whistle , which interacts with the Bison type.
Prior to its introduction, bovines have primary used the Ox type with the exception of Aurochs and the acorn Cow type.
Bison appeared in Avatar: The Last Airbender to represent the sky bison , which are bison that fly through airbending and steer through air currents with their broad tails.
